However, the shown webhook test assertion only covers the empty case (no destination calendar) and does not exercise the new non-empty array shape (e.g. `[ { externalId, ... } ]`). So the finding that existing tests can still pass while not covering the object→array payload shape change is grounded in the diff. The claim about real subscriber breakage is plausible but not directly verifiable from the diff alone.
